description: List who can sign in to the vendor portal: each supplier's active portal logins and pending invitations (id, supplier, email, name, status active|pending, invited and accepted dates, and forecastSharing: how much of the demand forecast that supplier is shown, Off|Forecast|ForecastAndOrderTiming), plus the profile fields a supplier must fill in when accepting. Optional supplier (id or name) narrows it to one supplier. The ids are what revoke_vendor_portal_access takes. Paged: pass limit (1–100) with offset; omit limit for every row up to 100, or PAGING_REQUIRED. While hasMore is true, call again with offset=nextOffset. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential and an Admin user.

limit.description: Page size (1–100). Omit for every row up to 100, else PAGING_REQUIRED.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset; requires limit when nonzero.

supplier.description: Optional supplier id (GUID) or exact name.

name: list_vendor_portal_users
title: List Vendor Portal Users
